title: Optimizers Explained in 45 Seconds (Adam, SGD, & More)
description:
Optimizers are how AI models actually learn — but most people make them way more complicated than they need to be.

Think of it like this: your model is stuck on a mountain in thick fog, and the optimizer is the strategy it uses to get down without messing up.

In this quick breakdown, I walk through:
 • SGD (slow but reliable)
 • Adagrad & RMSProp (adaptive learning)
 • Adam & AdamW (the go-to choices)
 • Newer ones like Lion & Lamb (for large-scale training)

If you’re building anything in AI or machine learning, this is all you really need to know to get started.

Simple, practical, no overthinking.
